channel.title: Sapling incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Sapling's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: linkerd expired anchors led to cluster downtime [resolved]
item.description: From 4:40am to 7:40am PST on Jan 25, 2026, the cluster experienced downtime due to expired trust anchors. New certs have been generated.

item.title: Chrome 144 breaking change for runtime.onMessage [resolved]
item.description: This has been resolved for over 6 days with the new integration. We left the message so those with the older integration would update.

item.title: AI detect downtime [resolved]
item.description: AWS cluster upgrades led to insufficient AI detection pod assignment, leading to latency and then downtime starting from 10:30am PST.

item.title: Downtime due to new AWS AMI upgrade [postmortem]
item.description:
AWS announced end of support for AMIs that Sapling used in its EKS cluster.
``` Amazon EKS will end support for EKS optimized AL2 AMIs on November 26, 2025. To avoid any disruptions, please migrate your workloads to alternative AMI types before November 26, 2025. ```
Around midnight Pacific Time on November 10, 2025, Sapling’s Helm configuration was updated with the updated AMIs.
No disruption was observed.
However, around 2am Pacific Time on November 11, 2025, the main backend K8S pods on Sapling were unable to be assigned to new nodes due to node affinity settings. This resulted in requests timing out and failing, affecting API, extension, and website users.
